trend: British Journal of Nutrition trial: high-dose caffeine plus L-theanine improved attention and reaction time after one night of no sleep
why: Honest read of a caffeine plus L-theanine study that notes its limits. Supports Mornings without a cure or performance claim.
text:
A trial found caffeine plus L-theanine improved attention and reaction time after one night without sleep.

It was one night and a high dose, so it says little about a normal Tuesday. The pairing in SILT Mornings is 80 mg caffeine with 200 mg L-theanine, written on the pack.
